name: fo-estate-income-tax
description: Prepare Faroese death-year income-tax and estate-income workpapers for 2026 deaths, separating the deceased, an undivided surviving spouse, public administration and private administration. Determines final provisional-tax treatment, an election for final assessment, inclusive settlement thresholds, opening information, estate-period income, the small-income exemption and the private-estate handoff to heirs. Covers tax carrying values, distributions of securities, current D03 probate fields, ordinary return procedures, deadlines and sanctions. Trigger on Faroe Islands deceased taxpayer, deyðsbúgv, final tax return after death, section 14 inventory and estate tax clearance. Inheritance duty uses the separate succession Guide. Precise unresolved allowance, payment and current-year return implementation branches stay explicit.
